subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifests larger than 16 MiB and symlinked manifest paths fail closed by default?
rationale: The implementation correctly removes the unbounded allocation path, but the threshold and regular-file-only requirement intentionally narrow inputs accepted by existing local and cloned marketplaces.

options.title: Accept the bounded manifest contract
options.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement with the proposed structured diagnostics.

options.title: Tune the marketplace boundary
options.body: Choose a different threshold or narrowly supported file layout while retaining bounded, race-aware reads.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded manifest contract
recommendation.body: Keep the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement with the proposed structured diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most recently maintained the marketplace loader contract affected by this decision.
